entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. It's just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really thought this would be great, but it's not for me. And I feel awful because I actually tried to return it weeks ago, right after I got it.
Okay, I see. Can you tell me what happened when you tried to return it previously?

Well, I went to the returns page, but there must have been a website error or something. The whole system seemed down. I kept trying to generate the return slip, but I couldn't print the label. It was so frustrating. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I was worried this would happen. I really needed this money back.

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry you experienced that with our site. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th, which was 24 days ago.
Yes, that's right. I'm worried I'm too late now because of the website problem.
Actually, you have nothing to worry about. I'm checking our policy right now, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, 90 days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so stressed about this. I thought it was much shorter. That's a huge relief.

Not at all. Since you're only on day 24, we can definitely get this processed for a full refund for you. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending you a new, valid return shipping label to the email address we have on file. Do you still have access to that one?
Yes, I do! Thank you, Sarah. You have no idea how much this helps. I was so worried. Thank you for making it so easy.

You're very welcome. Just print that label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
